findings.title: Garbled at_least_one_counted_reference description names E008
findings.detail: The sanity-check description reads 'F1(a): E008 INVALID if no reference remains E010 (D0021 item 2(b)): a SearchInfeasible exclusion (stage screen) counts like a TwinError.' make_spec.py appended the E010 clause to E008's text without fixing the id. Runner docstrings (e.g. line 255) also still say 'E008 is INVALID only if no reference remains'. Remedy: reword to 'E010 INVALID if no reference remains; a SearchInfeasible exclusion counts like a TwinError'.

findings.title: In-flight jobs of a SearchInfeasible reference are not cancelled, and the concurrent path is untested
findings.detail: Run.search_infeasible drops the reference's drivers and its queued jobs but not its running jobs. In a real run these can be the other namespace's screen (about 3 h on 2R) or L2 solves the main driver started after its screen finished, before the control screen failed. By code reading this is harmless to the verdict: step() only learns timing from them, and assemble_rows/evaluate skip excluded references. It still wastes VM time. The selftest's fake scheduler runs every job synchronously inside _launch and writes the screens before drive, so this concurrency path is never exercised. The case where the excluded reference was a non-default stack type's spot reference is also untested (fakes use DEFAULT_STACK only).
findings.evidence: e010_run.py Run.search_infeasible (deletes from sched.queue only); Scheduler._launch fake branch; search_infeasible_failures.screens() pre-writes every screen.json
findings.suggested_check: Selftest case with a real-subprocess or delayed fake scheduler in which main finishes and queues solves before control's screen fails.

findings.title: Planned 2R screen rate is Mac-timing dependent
findings.detail: --check-references on my rerun (machine under load from the parallel gate) gave a plan screen rate of 0.561 s per candidate against the spec's 0.527. This is a cost line only, and the Mac->VM factor for pure-Python sampling is declared an inference. The 320 vCPU-hour cap has a wide margin (upper 150.5).
